adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decrypted payload is processed as `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch and no schema validation of the resulting object before persisting it (`data: { key: keys }`). Since `reqBody.keys` is only validated as a string by zod, a request with a correct webhook secret but malformed ciphertext (or any decrypt/parse failure) will throw and yield an unhandled 500. Even if parsing succeeds, it can store an arbitrary JSON object into `credential.key`, potentially breaking downstream code that assumes a specific credential shape.
